bĭcămĕrātus , a, um, adj. bis-camera,
I.with a double vault, doubly arched: “cella,” Hier. ad Jovin. 1, 17 : ecclesia, Aug. Civ. Dei, 15, 26.—As subst.: bĭcămĕrātum , i, n., a receptacle with two compartments, Ambros. Hexaëm. 6, 9, 72.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
